title: Paula Harris gets an Audrey call about Crestone

tellings.quote: herself boy that's beautiful I'd like to go and the phone rang and Audrey is on the phone she says don't worry you'll go back

plain: A woman named Paola Harris was looking at Crestone, a small town in Colorado, and thinking to herself how beautiful it was and that she would like to go. Just then the phone rang. It was someone named Audrey, who told her not to worry, she would go back. The researcher Grant Cameron passes this on as something Harris told him, and he mentions the campaigner Steven Greer alongside it. It is told as a call that seemed to answer a thought Harris had never said out loud.
